sermon.title: Four Difficult Issues to Understand Part 3
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this third part Pastor David G. Kincer argues from Revelation 20, Psalm 90, 1 Corinthians 15 and 2 Peter 3 that the thousand years is a period of time in which Christ and his people already reign, that the first resurrection was the resurrection of Jesus and the saints of old, and that Gog and Magog stand for the deceived nations of the earth. He rejects the pre-tribulation rapture and says there is one second coming, with fire, and that believers should live holy lives now.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: the captions give “Revelations” for the book of Revelation; this is kept as spoken. Captions render Gog and Magog as “may God” and similar; they are shown as Gog and Magog. He reads Scripture in King James-style wording at points where the NKJV differs. He makes claims about other groups (the Catholic Church, the Jehovah’s Witnesses, homosexuality, and unnamed end-time preachers and their wealth); these are his words and not verified by this site. At about 22:00 the captions read “God doesn’t love the Jews anymore and he loves the Gentiles…”; the sentence is kept as captioned and should be checked against the audio. “[Unclear]” marks five spots: three at about 1:50, one at about 11:30 and one at about 27:40.

faqs.question: What does he say amillennialism is?
faqs.answer: He says it means “no millennial,” and calls it “the biggest accepted theory in the Christian world on the second coming.”

faqs.question: Does he say a church can get you to heaven?
faqs.answer: No. He says “no church can get you to heaven, you and Christ is what get you to heaven.”

faqs.question: What problem does he see with the rapture theory and the beheaded saints?
faqs.answer: He says if people who would not worship the beast were killed at the last day, “there’s no one on earth that’s serving Christ,” and “this is a problem of pre-tribulation rapture.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was committed to them. Then I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their witness to Jesus and for the word of God, who had not worshiped the beast or his image, and had not received his mark on their foreheads or on their hands. And they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

faqs.question: Does he say there is a second verse for a literal thousand-year reign?
faqs.answer: No. He says “we need another verse to back up that there is a literal thousand-year reign in Christ… and there isn’t one.”

faqs.question: What is his point about numerology?
faqs.answer: He says “numerology just accept numbers when it’s convenient to them,” and that applying one rule to every scripture gives “a problem.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: And I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred and sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

faqs.question: Does he say the second death has power over believers?
faqs.answer: No. He says “the second death has no power over you, period.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: But the rest of the dead did not live again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection. Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with Him a thousand years.

faqs.question: Who does he say rose when Jesus rose?
faqs.answer: He says “the saints of old” rose with him, “went into Jerusalem and appeared to many people,” and then ascended with him.

scriptures.text_nkjv: and the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised; and coming out of the graves after His resurrection, they went into the holy city and appeared to many.

faqs.question: What does he say the first resurrection is?
faqs.answer: He says it was “when Jesus rose from the grave, and the saints in the Old Testament rose with him,” and that faith in it “is what gives us power over the second death.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: But now Christ is risen from the dead, and has become the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep. For since by man came death, by Man also came the resurrection of the dead. For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ all shall be made alive. But each one in his own order: Christ the firstfruits, afterward those who are Christ’s at His coming.

faqs.question: Is Jesus ruling now, according to him?
faqs.answer: Yes. He says “he is king now” and “he reigns now until all enemies has been put under his feet.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then comes the end, when He delivers the kingdom to God the Father, when He puts an end to all rule and all authority and power. For He must reign till He has put all enemies under His feet. The last enemy that will be destroyed is death.

faqs.question: In short, who does he say Gog and Magog are?
faqs.answer: He says “it’s the nations of the earth that are deceived,” meaning “Gentiles, unbelievers.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now when the thousand years have expired, Satan will be released from his prison and will go out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle, whose number is as the sand of the sea. They went up on the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. And fire came down from God out of heaven and devoured them.

faqs.question: Does he say there is a rapture before the second coming?
faqs.answer: No. He says “there’s no rapture and then a second coming. There is a second coming.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will melt with fervent heat; both the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up. Therefore, since all these things will be dissolved, what manner of persons ought you to be in holy conduct and godliness, looking for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be dissolved, being on fire, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

faqs.question: What does he say we should focus on instead of the end time?
faqs.answer: He says “not looking for something special up there at the end,” but “now be focusing on living for God and speaking rightly.”
